purpose: A sentence of what a picture shows, written by a model (user 2026-11-10: Florence-2 as the second AI engine beside SigLIP: it names what it sees without a vocabulary), as a plug-in program beside the application. The AI catalog of the host names the program and the model; nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

captions.ok: { captions: [text] }: one English sentence or a few a picture, in the order given

rules: At most 8 pictures a request. The pictures are JPEG files in an empty temporary folder of the application; the plug-in reads them and the model and writes nothing. A picture it cannot read is an error, never a guess.
acceptance: crates/qnc-shot-caption-run/examples/caption_files.rs (the captions of pictures given, only read).
